'''2009 Bespin Regionals Max Mattese LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Max Mattese]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Credits
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
